summary: refactor(shared): move Node Sentry callers to @fxa/shared/sentry-node
description:
Because:

- Node callers still import Sentry from fxa-shared/sentry, which FxA will remove.

This commit:

- Moves the Node Sentry imports in fxa-auth-server, fxa-admin-panel server, fxa-admin-server and fxa-event-broker to @fxa/shared/sentry-node.
- Adds the @fxa/shared/sentry-node path to two tsconfig.build.json files.
- Types the mozlog logger as ILogger in two monitoring.ts files.

Closes FXA-14700
